mapper.insert: INSERT INTO broker_order_attempt (client_order_key, stock_code, side, quantity, mode, raw_response, reasoning, signal_id, reason_snapshot, created_at) VALUES (#{clientOrderKey}, #{stockCode}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{mode}, #{rawResponse}, #{reasoning}, #{signalId}, #{reasonSnapshot}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, client_order_key AS clientOrderKey, stock_code AS stockCode, side, quantity, mode, raw_response AS rawResponse, reasoning, signal_id AS signalId, reason_snapshot AS reasonSnapshot, created_at AS createdAt FROM broker_order_attempt ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
